description: Computes deterministic fair market value (USD), yield-to-maturity (approximate and exact cashflow YTM %), Macaulay and modified duration (years), convexity, DV01 (USD per 1bp shift), and Merton jump-diffusion 95% confidence bounds for a single corporate, sovereign, or RWA fixed-income security. Use when: pricing or analyzing an individual bond CUSIP/ticker given par value, coupon, maturity, and clean market price. Do not use when: scanning FINRA TRACE secondary dealer prints or structuring single-security option collars (use get_debt_radar instead), or running multi-position portfolio macro shocks and VaR/CVaR (use run_portfolio_stress_test instead). Behavior: Read-only, deterministic, side-effect-free calculation ($0.50 USD per call via HTTP header x-api-key or x-payment-token; returns an x402/MPP paymentChallenge without charging if credentials are omitted).

asset_type.description: Fixed-income instrument classification governing jump-diffusion volatility calibration (default: "CORPORATE_BOND").

coupon_rate.description: Annualized stated coupon rate as a percentage (e.g., 6.25 for 6.25% paid semi-annually; default: resolved from security master or 6.25).

cusip.description: 9-character alphanumeric CUSIP security identifier (e.g., "912828ZG2", "037833EK1", "38141GZX8"). Defaults to "912828ZG2" if omitted.

face_value.description: Par / notional principal face value in USD (positive number, e.g., 1000000 for $1M par; default: 1000000).

market_price.description: Current clean market trading price expressed as a percentage of par (e.g., 93.50 for 93.50% of par; default: 93.50).

maturity_years.description: Remaining time to stated maturity in years (minimum 0.5, e.g., 5.0 for 5 years; default: 5.0).

ticker.description: Optional issuer ticker symbol used as fallback lookup when CUSIP is omitted (e.g., "UST-5Y", "AAPL", "GS").

name: get_cusip_valuation

credit_rating.description: Composite institutional credit rating (e.g., AAA, AA, BBB).

dv01_usd.description: Dollar value of a 1 basis point (0.01%) parallel yield shift in USD.

exact_cashflow_ytm_pct.description: Exact Newton-Raphson semi-annual cashflow yield-to-maturity percentage.

exact_modified_duration_years.description: Exact semi-annual cashflow modified duration in years.

issuer_name.description: Legal name of the issuing entity.

jump_diffusion_95_bounds_usd.description: Merton jump-diffusion 1-year 95% confidence interval bounds in USD.

annual_total_volatility_pct.description: Combined diffusive and Poisson jump annualized volatility %.

lower_bound_usd.description: 95% downside tail valuation bound in USD.

market_value_usd.description: Current mark-to-market position value in USD.

modified_duration_years.description: Approximate interest-rate sensitivity modified duration in years.

receipt.description: Cryptographic payment or API key settlement receipt ID.

recommendation.description: Deterministic relative-value signal based on clean price vs. par.

title: Single-Bond CUSIP Valuation & Jump-Diffusion Analytics
